title: Spank: Slap your MacBook, it yells back. Uses Apple Silicon accelerometer via IOKit HID

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Ever been so frustrated debugging that you wanted to smack your MacBook? Now it will actually respond. Spank uses the built-in accelerometer on Apple Silicon Max to detect when you physically slap your laptop and plays sound effects in response. Three modes: pain. Mac yells, "Ow!" Halo, Halo, death sound, and sexy. Intensity increases with repeated hits over 5 minutes. Completely useless. Guaranteed to get a laugh. Just don't break your screen.
